description: Land Title Settlement Department - Weligalla, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320236
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, locations, and owner details. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on the registration and settlement of land titles, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
